slides.texte_overlay: how to improve your social life

1. say yes to the second invitation

the first one is scary.
the second one is where friendships start.

2. join something weekly

a choir, a book club, a class.
seeing the same faces does the work.

3. be the one who plans

people love going out.
they just hate organising.

4. remember the small things

her exam, his new job.
ask about it next time.

5. have something to share

before, i never knew what to talk about.
now i learn one new thing every morning. and conversations just flow.
